{{Quote|We are mercenaries that specialize in search, locate and annihilate missions. ''[...]'' We do not advertise. Most of our jobs come from references and repeat customers. With a 99.26% mission success rate, we maintain a waiting list of interested clients.|[[Loruna Scathe]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TAC" />}}
The '''Azure Cabal''' was a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] organization.

==History==
The Azure Cabal was formed by [[Loruna Scathe]], a former [[Mistryl Shadow Guard]] member, who learned the truth about the origins of the Guard and left it. The Cabal competed with the Shadow Guard for the same kinds of contracts, so she maintained tight secrecy for the safety of herself, her people and her clients. To avoid conflict with the Mistryl Shadow Guards or attract the attention of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], the Cabal was organized to consist of scattered, but highly capable mercenaries that operated throughout the galaxy. Each member of the inner-circle solicited mercenary contracts from specific contacts to avoid undue attention.<ref name="TAC">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=66937&resource=features|text=The Azure Cabal}}</ref>

Various mercenaries and rogues sought out employment with the Cabal, but in order to reach the inner-circle, they had to succeed in surviving a number of tough tests. A [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] succeeded in doing so<ref name="SWG:TAC" /> in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> 

{{Company-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Azure Cabal appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TAC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Azure Cabal quest series was added to the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 6 Notes for May 22 2007|Chapter 6]]" update, on [[May 22]], [[2007]].<ref name="Chapter 6">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67250&month=052007|text=Publish Notes &ndash; Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild}}</ref>
